description: This file defines the AddLeaveActivity class for the Android application, which allows users to input and save leave details such as title, date, type, and description. It manages UI components, date picker dialog, and interacts with the CalendarRepository to save leave data.

classes.name: AddLeaveActivity
classes.description: An Activity class that provides a user interface to add leave entries with input fields for title, date, type, and description, and saves the leave data via a repository.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and calls setup functions for views, type spinner, date picker, and save button.

methods.name: initViews
methods.description: Finds and assigns UI components to class properties, and sets initial date in the date editor.

methods.name: setupTypeSpinner
methods.description: Populates the leave type dropdown with options for personal, sick, and casual leave.

methods.name: setupDatePicker
methods.description: Sets up a date picker dialog to select a date and update the date edit field.

methods.name: setupSaveButton
methods.description: Defines the behavior when clicking the save button: validates input, creates a Leave object, and saves it through the repository, then shows a toast and finishes the activity.
